Evaluation measures a solution against the original user requirements and design criteria. It asks whether the solution meets the design, whether it is complete (every requirement implemented and working), whether it is efficient (fast, economical with resources and easy for the user), and whether it is robust (it copes with invalid, unexpected and large volumes of data without failing).
